programs.description: Karan, an aimless young man, joins the Indian Army on a whim but backs out when he finds a soldier's life to be difficult. When this creates conflict with his girlfriend, he rejoins to make her proud.
Chenna is smitten by Cheluvi, a girl who works in his factory. However, with Chenna's jealous manager in the picture, the lovers struggle to enjoy their developing romance.
